title: Public Domain Hymns (Hymnary.org)
tradition_notes: Cross-denominational collection sourced from Hymnary.org. Covers hymns from Anglican, Lutheran, Methodist, Presbyterian, Baptist, and other traditions. Non-English hymns include German, Norwegian, Danish, Polish, and Arabic sources.
notes: Data provided directly by Hymnary.org. Each record is the oldest known public-domain hymnal instance for that text. Please link to https://hymnary.org when using this dataset, and encourage application developers to submit their projects to Hymnary at https://hymnary.org/contact.
